title: Website blocked by the firewall
symptom: A website needed for work is blocked by the company web filter
user_description: I need a supplier's website for a quote and it shows a blocked page from our firewall. Can you just unblock it, or can I use my phone's hotspot?

options.text: Use a VPN or proxy to get around the block
options.why: Bypassing company security breaks policy and can let threats in.

options.text: Turn off the firewall on his PC
options.why: The block is on the company filter, and turning off his PC's firewall only adds risk.

options.text: Read the block page (it shows the category), confirm the business need, and send a request with manager approval to whoever manages the web filter
options.why: Sites are blocked for a reason, but mistakes happen. The proper request lets the right team check the site and allow it safely.

options.text: Let him connect the work PC to his personal hotspot
options.why: Takes the PC outside the company's protection.

hints: What does the block page tell you?
Who decides which sites are allowed?
Why not just go around it?
real_world_tip: Sites are sometimes put in the wrong category. Include the full address and why it is needed, so the team can review it quickly.
